notes: Thermal, energy, logistics and integration details come from general knowledge, not the evidence.

mineral_based_product.value: Mineral fiber ceiling tiles and panels, plus metal and wood ceilings, wall systems and suspension grid

thermal_processing_dependence.value: Mineral fiber ceiling tile production uses drying ovens; no cement kiln or glass furnace

energy_fuel_intensity.value: Natural gas-fired drying of mineral fiber tile and steel grid manufacturing; energy use is moderate

delivery_radius_product_logistics.value: Plants and distribution serve customers across North America, with ordering and delivery through distributors and contractors

construction_end_use.value: Commercial and institutional interiors (offices, schools, healthcare), plus residential ceilings and walls; renovation and new construction

raw_material_integration_model.value: Vertically integrated in grid and tile manufacturing; buys raw materials such as perlite, clay, starch, recycled paper and steel
